subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should ClickClack JSON reads and mutating REST writes share an unconditional 30-second completion deadline while multipart uploads remain exempt?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the deadline works, but repository evidence does not define the service latency, ambiguous-write, or upload-duration contract needed to approve the compatibility tradeoff automatically.

options.title: Approve current deadline
options.body: Accept 30 seconds for bounded JSON reads and writes, including ambiguous committed-write failures, and keep multipart exempt for this PR.

options.title: Split read and write policy
options.body: Require separate owner-approved behavior for mutating calls, such as a distinct deadline or idempotency and reconciliation contract, before merge.

options.title: Pause for service contract
options.body: Hold the PR until ClickClack latency and upload timeout expectations are documented well enough to choose one policy.

recommendation.title: Approve current deadline
recommendation.body: Accept 30 seconds for bounded JSON reads and writes, including ambiguous committed-write failures, and keep multipart exempt for this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged ClickClack activity work is the clearest current-main history touching mutating REST traffic through this client.
